title: Treasury Schedule of Purchase Seasoning Periods for Class H Preferred Stock — Member Equities & Patronage
content:
The purchase seasoning period of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding rests on the holding's age: for a holding issued at least 120 whole months before today, purchases are unseasoned for 6 whole months; for a holding issued at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before today, for 9 whole months; for a younger holding, for 12 whole months.

## Schedule

| Age of the holding (whole months from its issue date to today) | Purchases are unseasoned for |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 6 whole months |
| 60 or more but fewer than 120 | 9 whole months |
| Fewer than 60 | 12 whole months |

The holding's unseasoned purchases are the purchases dated within that many whole months back from today, counting whole calendar months; they are the purchase part of the holding's unseasoned shares, which are not redeemable.

## Cases (hypothetical holding with purchases of USD 5,000.00 dated 4 months ago and USD 3,000.00 dated 8 months ago)

| Age of the holding | Seasoning period | Unseasoned purchases |
|---|---|---|
| 130 whole months | 6 whole months | USD 5,000.00 |
| 70 whole months | 9 whole months | USD 8,000.00 |
| 30 whole months | 12 whole months | USD 8,000.00 |

At the edges, a holding of 59 whole months takes 12 whole months, one of 60 takes 9, one of 119 takes 9 and one of 120 takes 6.
